grammar_focus: KS16+KS40 真实与非真实条件句(真实:if+一般现在→will/shall;与现在相反:if+过去式/were→would+原形;与过去相反:if+had done→would have done)+ suggest/demand that…should(虚拟)(教材 L64 Key structures)主考;SD 短语动词 draw 辨析 draw in/back/off/up(吸入/退回/开走/停下·拟定)(辅考)
scene: 1858年,一位名叫埃梅·托梅·德·干蒙的法国工程师带着建造一条长21英里、穿越英吉利海峡的隧道计划到了英国。他说,可以在隧道中央建造一座平台,这座平台将用作码头和火车站。如果再建些伸出海面的高大烟囱状通风管,隧道就具备了良好的通风条件。1860年,一位名叫威廉·洛的英国人提出了一项更好的计划。他提议建一条双轨隧道,这样就解决了通风问题。因为如果有一列火车开进隧道,它就把新鲜空气随之抽进了隧道。42年以后,隧道实际已经开始建了。如果不是因为那时英国人害怕入侵,隧道早已建成了。世界不得不再等将近100年才看到海峡隧道竣工。它于1994年3月7日正式开通,将英国与欧洲大陆连到了一起。

grammar_card.title: 真实与非真实条件句
grammar_card.intro: KS16+KS40 条件句三种:①真实条件(可能发生)——if + 一般现在时,主句用 will/shall(If it is fine, we shall go);②与现在/将来事实相反——if + 过去式(be 一律用 were),主句用 would + 原形(If I were you, I would go);③与过去事实相反——if + had done,主句用 would have done(If he had hurried, he would have caught it)。另:suggest/demand/recommend 后的 that 从句用 should + 原形(should 常省略)。

specialRules.rule: 与现在事实相反时,条件句里的 be 动词一律用 were,不用 was:If I were you… / If father were alive…。
SD 短语动词 draw + 副词各义不同:draw in=吸入(draw in fresh air);draw back=退回(drew back in terror);draw off=开走(the taxi drew off);draw up=①(车)停下(the car drew up)②拟定/签订(draw up a plan / an agreement was drawn up)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why was the first tunnel not completed?
options: At the time the British feared invasion
The sea was far too deep

passage: In 1858, a French engineer, Aimé Thomé de Gamond, arrived in England with a plan for a twenty-one-mile tunnel under the English Channel. He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the center of the Channel. This platform would serve as a port and a railroad station. The tunnel would be well-ventilated if tall chimneys were built above sea level. In 1860, a better plan was put forward by an Englishman, William Low. He suggested that a double railroad-tunnel should be built. This would solve the problem of ventilation, for if a train entered this tunnel, it would draw in fresh air behind it. Forty-two years later a tunnel was actually begun. If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed. The world had to wait almost another 100 years for the Channel Tunnel. It was officially opened on March 7, 1994, finally connecting Britain to the European continent.

stage5.stem: "If it ___ fine tomorrow, we shall go for a swim."(真实条件句:if 从句用一般现在表将来)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果明天天气好,我们就去游泳。

stage5.stem: "You'll miss the train if you ___ hurry."(真实条件句)
stage5.stem_cn: 你要是不赶紧就赶不上火车了。

stage5.stem: "If he ___ out, I'll call again tomorrow."(真实条件句:if 从句用一般现在)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果他不在,我明天再打电话。

stage5.stem: "If you ___ to the exhibition, you would enjoy it."(与现在/将来相反:if 从句用过去式)
stage5.stem_cn: 你要是去看那个展览,会很喜欢的。

stage5.stem: "If I ___ in your position, I would act differently."(与现在相反的假设,be 动词用特殊虚拟形式)
stage5.stem_cn: 我要是处在你的位置,会采取不同的做法。

stage5.stem: "If father ___ alive, he would be horrified."(与现在事实相反,be 动词用特殊虚拟形式)
stage5.stem_cn: 父亲若还在世,会惊骇不已。

stage5.stem: "If the British had not feared invasion, the tunnel ___ completed."(与过去相反:主句用 would have + 过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果不是当时英国人害怕入侵,隧道早就建成了。

stage5.stem: "You ___ missed the train if you had not hurried."(与过去事实相反,主句用完成体的虚拟形式)
stage5.stem_cn: 你要是当时不赶紧,就赶不上火车了。

stage5.stem: "If you ___ to the exhibition, you would have enjoyed it."(与过去相反:if 从句用过去完成时)
stage5.stem_cn: 你当时要是去过那个展览,就会喜欢的。

stage5.stem: "If you had told me earlier, I ___ able to help you."(与过去相反:主句用 would have + 过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 你要是早点告诉我,我就能帮你了。

stage5.stem: "He suggested that a double railroad-tunnel ___ built."(suggest 后的从句用 should + 原形)
stage5.stem_cn: 他建议应当建造一条双轨隧道。

stage5.stem: "The manager demanded that the report ___ finished at once."(demand 后的从句用 should + 原形)
stage5.stem_cn: 经理要求报告立即完成。

stage5.stem: "If a train entered this tunnel, it would ___ fresh air behind it."(短语动词:把新鲜空气'吸入')
stage5.stem_cn: 火车开进隧道会把新鲜空气吸进来。

stage5.stem: "The dog ___ in terror when it saw the snake."(短语动词:惊恐地'退回')
stage5.stem_cn: 那条狗看见蛇,惊恐地退了回来。

stage5.stem: "Two men got out and then the taxi ___."(短语动词:车'开走了')
stage5.stem_cn: 两个男人下了车,然后出租车开走了。

stage5.stem: "The car ___ outside the cinema."(短语动词:车'停了下来')
stage5.stem_cn: 汽车在电影院外停了下来。

stage5.stem: "We shall have to ___ a new plan."(短语动词:'拟定'一项新计划)
stage5.stem_cn: 我们得拟定一项新计划。

stage5.stem: "A new trading agreement was ___ between Holland and Denmark."(短语动词:'签订、拟定'协议)
stage5.stem_cn: 荷兰和丹麦签署了一项新的贸易协定。
